description:
£120 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to welcome to the market this stylish three bedroom apartment, situated on the fourth floor in the heart of Newcastle city centre.

Ideally located within easy walking distance of the Quayside, city centre, universities and main rail links, this fantastic apartment offers the perfect base for students looking to enjoy everything Newcastle has to offer.

The property features a modern fitted kitchen and a spacious lounge, providing an excellent communal area for relaxing and socialising with housemates. Recently redecorated throughout, the apartment benefits from new wood effect laminate flooring, fresh curtains, updated lighting and stylish prints in the living room, creating a contemporary and welcoming feel.

The apartment offers four bedrooms, one of which benefits from its own en-suite shower room. Further improvements include new wood-effect laminate flooring to be laid in all bedrooms, along with brand-new bed frames, ensuring the accommodation is fresh and ready for the next tenants.

Combining modern interiors with a prime city-centre location, this property is an excellent choice for students seeking comfortable and convenient accommodation close to local amenities and university campuses.

To arrange a viewing, contact My Property Box on 0191 212 0400 today!
